# MathBrooks

> MathBrooks builds custom software, business platforms, workflow automation, and applied AI systems for operations-heavy businesses across Africa.

MathBrooks is a software engineering company based in Harare, Zimbabwe. The company helps teams replace fragmented spreadsheets, manual approvals, scattered customer records, and slow reporting with practical business systems.

## Core Services

- Custom software development: internal tools, client portals, operational platforms, integrations, and reporting systems built around real workflows.
- Business platform implementation: CRM, HR and payroll, accounting, projects, inventory, analytics, automation, and AI assistant modules.
- Workflow automation: approval routing, document handoffs, notifications, recurring reports, and connected business processes.
- Applied AI systems: copilots, classification workflows, agentic systems, voice workflows, decision support, and governed business assistants.

## Solutions

- MathBrooks CRM: pipeline visibility, customer history, follow-up discipline, and sales reporting.
- MathBrooks HR & Payroll: employee records, payroll workflows, leave management, approvals, and Zimbabwean compliance readiness.
- MathBrooks Accounting: practical finance operations, collections follow-up, reporting, and management visibility.
- MathBrooks Projects: task boards, owner assignments, client milestones, and status reporting.
- MathBrooks Inventory: supplier queues, purchase requests, receipts, restock priorities, and stock visibility.
- MathBrooks Analytics: dashboards, alerts, and reporting shaped around operational questions.
- MathBrooks Automation: governed workflow automation for repeated business processes.
- MathBrooks AI Assistant: a governed business intelligence layer for asking questions across connected operations.

## Best-Fit Customers

- Owner-led businesses that need better sales, finance, HR, or operational visibility.
- African and regional companies that need practical software adapted to local workflows.
- Teams that have outgrown spreadsheets but do not want oversized enterprise software.
- Businesses that need custom systems, AI-assisted workflows, or automation tied to real processes.
